name: Alsós
summary: Elaborate Hungarian 3-player point-trick game with trumps, melds and extra feats (figurák).
rules_text: Alsós uses a 32-card Hungarian pack, Ace to Seven. Deal 6 cards each, expose a trump indicator and bottom card, then deal 3 more unseen. Bid counter-clockwise: first round accept proposed trump to play solo vs alliance; if all pass, second round bid other trump or no-trump; if all pass again, bid Betli to lose all tricks. Players announce figurák extra feats and can kontra opponents to double. Pick up last 3 cards for 9-card hands. Holder of lowest trump may do síber exchange for undealt cards if condition met; holder of Seven of trumps may exchange for indicator. On first trick players may declare sequences of 3+ cards, sets of four, and Béla King+Over of trumps; best meld of each type scores. Play 9 tricks, must follow suit, trump if void when trumps exist. Last trick bonus 10. Count card points: trump Under 20, Nine 14, Ace 11 etc.; non-trump Ace 11 etc. Solo needs majority of 162 points (130 at no-trump) to win game and figurák, scoring independently.
